## About
Modern And Unique Interiors LLC is a general contractor based in Irvine, focused on interior remodeling, renovation and flooring.
We hold a 5 rating on Google from 35 reviews. One customer wrote that Emanuel and his team finished the work quickly and flawlessly. Another said the owner is friendly and transparent, and that working with us felt like family.
We keep you in the loop, respect the timeline, and want the finished room to look clean and modern.

## Services
- Interior remodeling and renovation: Remodeling work that leaves your rooms looking modern, clean and finished well.
- Flooring: Flooring installed with precision and care as part of your interior project.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours on Saturday?
A: We're open Saturday from 7:00 AM to 7:00 PM, the same hours as weekdays.

Q: Are you open on Sunday?
A: No, we're closed on Sunday. Reach out any other day of the week.

Q: What kind of work do you do?
A: We do interior remodeling and renovation, including flooring and other interior work.
